objective: Support the April 10 reel with a calmer, highly readable 2-frame Story that reframes aging into a daily-foundation lens and routes viewers back to the reel.
visual_engine: dual-image story with structured support frame

fallback_source: Regenerate individual plates if subject age, openness, or text-safe space drift; do not switch to stock or reused plates.

clear route back to the reel

do not generate fake instagram UI
do not add any text beyond the copy lock below
avoid repeated right-facing portrait grammar from nearby stories
keep typography large enough for normal Instagram viewing distance
protect the copy zone from the image focal area

frame 2 uses a quieter editorial home-detail plate with a centered frosted support card and one smaller route-back card below
